article.title: AdMaven邀請制推出Mave，廣告變更須批准確認卡
article.title_en: AdMaven rolls out invite-only Mave with approval cards
article.summary: AdMaven在廣告主儀表板加入Mave，以對話處理pop廣告建案、帳戶分析及設定調整。
article.summary_en: AdMaven added Mave to its advertiser dashboard for conversational pop-campaign creation, account analysis and settings changes.
highlights: 變動須由廣告主批准確認卡，卡片10分鐘後失效。
服務按帳戶邀請開放；API問答屬唯讀，不能據此修改活動。
highlights_en: Changes require an advertiser's confirmation card, which expires after10 minutes.
Access rolls out by invitation per account; API Q&A is read-only.
article.why: 媒體操作可從分析直接形成待批准變更，團隊可決定哪些批次暫停或預算調整適合用確認卡覆查。
article.why_en: Media teams can assess which batch pauses or budget adjustments suit a reviewed confirmation card.
article.next_step: 取得邀請後，先以少量活動提出暫停建議，逐項對照活動名稱及擬改狀態，在確認卡有效期內決定是否執行。
article.next_step_en: After receiving access, propose pauses for a small group and reconcile campaign names and states before the card expires.
article.detail: 官方表示可一次建立最多5個pop活動，或批次暫停、恢復最多20個活動。Pop是彈出式廣告格式，仍須經標準素材審核。Mave亦可按國家、裝置及流量來源拆解資料。團隊可先把唯讀查詢與實際寫入分開，確認卡片顯示的對象和設定完整，再擴大批次操作範圍。
article.detail_en: The company lists creation of up to 5 pop campaigns and batch pause/resume for up to 20. Pop ads are pop-up formats and still undergo normal creative review. Keep read-only analysis separate from writes, and inspect the objects and settings on each card before scaling batch work.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
